questions.question: Why are aircraft more often painted than not?
questions.idealAnswer: Paint protects the integrity of the Airframe from corrosion and deterioration. A properly painted aircraft is easier to clean, and dirt and debris is less likely to adhere to the painted surface that can help cause corrosion.

concepts.label: Paint protects the integrity of the Airframe from corrosion
terms: paint protects the integrity of the airframe from corrosion

concepts.label: deterioration. A properly painted aircraft is easier to clean
terms: deterioration. a properly painted aircraft is easier to clean

concepts.label: debris is less likely to adhere to the painted surface that can help cause corrosion
terms: debris is less likely to adhere to the painted surface that can help cause corrosion

questions.question: What is the purpose of a primer when preparing an aircraft for painting?
questions.idealAnswer: A primer is the foundation of the finish. Its role is to bond to the surface, inhibit corrosion of metal, and provide an anchor point for the finish coats.

concepts.label: A primer is the foundation of the finish. Its role is to bond to the surface
terms: a primer is the foundation of the finish. its role is to bond to the surface

concepts.label: provide an anchor point for the finish coats
terms: provide an anchor point for the finish coats

questions.question: Name at least three types of primers used in aviation.
questions.idealAnswer: Wash primers, grey enamel undercoat, urethane, epoxy, and zinc chromate.

questions.question: Why is it important that primers and paint be of the same brand when painting an aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: It is important that all products used to paint the aircraft be of the same brand because they may not be compatible each other, and their is a high risk of ruining the entire paint job.

concepts.label: It is important that all products used to paint the aircraft be of the same brand because
terms: it is important that all products used to paint the aircraft be of the same brand because they may not be compatible each other

concepts.label: their is a high risk of ruining the entire paint job
terms: their is a high risk of ruining the entire paint job

questions.question: What are some of the effects of ambient conditions on finishing materials?
questions.idealAnswer: Changes in temperature can cause blushing and orange peel. Also rapid changes in ambient temperatures while spaying may cause an uneven release of the solvents, causing the surface to dry, shrink and wrinkle.

concepts.label: Changes in temperature can cause blushing
terms: changes in temperature can cause blushing

concepts.label: orange peel. Also rapid changes in ambient temperatures while spaying may cause an uneven
terms: orange peel. also rapid changes in ambient temperatures while spaying may cause an uneven release of the solvents

questions.question: What causes poor adhesion?
questions.idealAnswer: Improperly cleaned and prepared surfaces.

questions.question: What regulation provides the requirements for registration markings?
questions.idealAnswer: Title 14 of the code of federal regulations(14 CFR), part 45 identification and Registration Marking.

concepts.label: Title 14 of the code of federal regulations
terms: title 14 of the code of federal regulations

questions.question: What can cause runs and sags in aircraft finishes?
questions.idealAnswer: Painting to close to the surface or applying too heavy of a coat in a small area, or moving gun too slowly across the surface.

concepts.label: Painting to close to the surface or applying too heavy of a coat in a small area
terms: painting to close to the surface or applying too heavy of a coat in a small area

concepts.label: or moving gun too slowly across the surface
terms: or moving gun too slowly across the surface

questions.question: What are the basic requirements for identification and registration marking for an aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: Markings must be painted or be affixed by other means to assure a similar degree of permanence; have no ornamentation; contrast in color with background; and be legible.

concepts.label: Markings must be painted or be affixed by other means to assure a similar degree of perman
terms: markings must be painted or be affixed by other means to assure a similar degree of permanence

questions.question: What can cause "orange peel" on a painted surface?
questions.idealAnswer: Improper adjustment of the spray gun is most common. Also not enough reducer, (too thick) or wrong type of reducer for the ambient temperature, material not uniformly mixed, forced drying, too little flash time between coats, or spraying when the surface is too hot or too cold.

concepts.label: Improper adjustment of the spray gun is most common. Also not enough reducer
terms: improper adjustment of the spray gun is most common. also not enough reducer

concepts.label: or wrong type of reducer for the ambient temperature
terms: or wrong type of reducer for the ambient temperature

concepts.label: too little flash time between coats
terms: too little flash time between coats

concepts.label: or spraying when the surface is too hot or too cold
terms: or spraying when the surface is too hot or too cold

questions.question: What causes a fish eye appearance after painting?
questions.idealAnswer: Improper cleaning of the surface.

questions.question: What personal protective equipment should be used when mixing any paint or two- part coatings?
questions.idealAnswer: Eye protection and respirators should be worn at a minimum, protective clothing and gloves are recommended.

concepts.label: respirators should be worn at a minimum
terms: respirators should be worn at a minimum

questions.question: Where can you find safety, hazard, health, and environmental information about finishing products?
questions.idealAnswer: Material and safety data sheets (MSDS)

questions.question: Where should paint and solvent soaked rags be disposed of?
questions.idealAnswer: In fire proof containers.

questions.question: Why should wooden wing spars be finished with a transparent varnish?
questions.idealAnswer: Not only does it protect the structure, any decay or rot that may develop in the wood will be made visible.

concepts.label: Not only does it protect the structure
terms: not only does it protect the structure

concepts.label: any decay or rot that may develop in the wood will be made visible
terms: any decay or rot that may develop in the wood will be made visible

questions.question: Why is retarder used in dope when dope is applied in humid conditions?
questions.idealAnswer: Retarder slows the drying time of the dope and prevents blushing.

concepts.label: Retarder slows the drying time of the dope
terms: retarder slows the drying time of the dope

questions.question: What is used as a protective finish for the inside of steel tubing?
questions.idealAnswer: Hot Linseed oil is used.

questions.question: How thick should a coat of wash primer be on aluminum alloy aircraft structure?
questions.idealAnswer: Thin enough to not hide the metal surface.

questions.question: What happens to an enamel finish when paint remover is applied to it?
questions.idealAnswer: Enamel softens and swells, then pulls away from the surface.

concepts.label: then pulls away from the surface
terms: then pulls away from the surface

questions.question: What should be done to an aircraft surface that is covered with paint remover to give the remover the max amount of time to soak into the old finish?
questions.idealAnswer: Surface should be covered with a piece of paint drop cloth (poly-ethylene sheeting), this keeps solvents from evaporating before they can penetrate the old paint finish.

concepts.label: Surface should be covered with a piece of paint drop cloth
terms: surface should be covered with a piece of paint drop cloth

concepts.label: this keeps solvents from evaporating before they can penetrate the old paint finish
terms: this keeps solvents from evaporating before they can penetrate the old paint finish

questions.question: When mixing epoxy paint, should the converter be added to resin or resin added to converter?
questions.idealAnswer: Converter to resin; never resin to converter

questions.question: What is the general reason for runs and sags in a finish sprayed onto flat surfaces?
questions.idealAnswer: Too much paint applied, (moving to slow across surface); film too thick (too close to the surface when applying paint), or inadequate surface prep.

questions.question: What can be done to remedy blushing formed on a doped surface that was just sprayed?
questions.idealAnswer: Spray on light mist mixture (one part retarder: two parts thinner) over blushing area, allow it to dry, then add a second coat; if that does not work, sand off and apply new dope.

concepts.label: Spray on light mist mixture over blushing area
terms: spray on light mist mixture over blushing area

questions.question: How can a vinyl film decal be removed from an aluminum alloy surface?
questions.idealAnswer: MEK (Methyl Ethyl Ketone) saturated cloth over the decal until it softens, then scrape off with a plastic scraper.

concepts.label: MEK saturated cloth over the decal until it softens
terms: mek saturated cloth over the decal until it softens

concepts.label: then scrape off with a plastic scraper
terms: then scrape off with a plastic scraper

questions.question: What safety precaution must be observed when sweeping a paint room that has dried dope or lacquer overspray on the floor?
questions.idealAnswer: Wet down the floor with water before sweeping; static electricity from dry sweeping can cause a fire. (Dried paint dust is very flammable, static electricity can easily ignite the dried paint dust.)

concepts.label: Wet down the floor with water before sweeping
terms: wet down the floor with water before sweeping

concepts.label: static electricity from dry sweeping can cause a fire
terms: static electricity from dry sweeping can cause a fire

questions.question: What happens if dope is sprayed over an enameled surface?
questions.idealAnswer: The thinner in the dope will penetrate the enamel surface and cause it to swell.

concepts.label: The thinner in the dope will penetrate the enamel surface
terms: the thinner in the dope will penetrate the enamel surface

questions.question: How is the finish removed from a fiberglass aircraft component that is being repaired?
questions.idealAnswer: Sanding (Slow), Media basting can also be used ( with soft media ) moving quickly across the surface. Never use paint remover on composites. Paint remover would soften the resin in the composite structure.

concepts.label: Media basting can also be used moving quickly across the surface. Never use paint remover
terms: media basting can also be used moving quickly across the surface. never use paint remover on composites. paint remover would soften the resin in the composite structure

questions.question: What are the two basic types of dope that are used on fabric-covered aircraft?
questions.idealAnswer: Nitrate dope and CAB (cellulose acetate butyrate. )

questions.question: What kind of dope is used on polyester synthetic fabric which has been heat-shrunk on aircraft structure?
questions.idealAnswer: Non-tautening butyrate dope.

questions.question: Why is butyrate dope safer to use than nitrate dope?
questions.idealAnswer: Butyrate dope is a lot less flammable than Nitrate dope.

questions.question: What is the appearance of a blushing paint finish?
questions.idealAnswer: The paint will look chalky or cloudy

questions.question: What finishing defect is the result of a paint room temperature that is too warm?
questions.idealAnswer: Pin holes or blisters may develop on the surface.

questions.question: What causes dope to blush?
questions.idealAnswer: High humidity, moisture in the lines of the spray system, or paint application over a damp surface.

concepts.label: moisture in the lines of the spray system
terms: moisture in the lines of the spray system

concepts.label: or paint application over a damp surface
terms: or paint application over a damp surface

questions.question: What components or parts of the airframe must be protected from damage when using paint strippers?
questions.idealAnswer: The windshields, windows, plastics, composites, synthetic rubbers, fabrics, and static ports.

questions.question: What is the function of primers or wash primers?
questions.idealAnswer: To provide corrosion protection , and give a good bonding surface between the metal and the topcoats.

concepts.label: give a good bonding surface between the metal
terms: give a good bonding surface between the metal

questions.question: Name several common types of paint used on aircraft.
questions.idealAnswer: They are, primers, wash primers, synthetic enamels, acrylic lacquers, and polyurethane.

questions.question: What health and safety precautions must be observed when using toxic solvents and thinners which are part of modern finishing systems?
questions.idealAnswer: Person or persons, working with toxic solvents and paint must wear respirators, masks, and protective clothing.

questions.question: When spray painting causes a surface to appear dry and rough, what are the most likely causes?
questions.idealAnswer: Too much air pressure in the gun or the gun is too far from the painting surface.

questions.question: What causes ‘Orange Peel’?
questions.idealAnswer: The spray pressure is too high, cold temperatures, damp draft over the surface, or thinner drying too fast.

concepts.label: The spray pressure is too high
terms: the spray pressure is too high

questions.question: Other than appearance, what is another reason for touching up painted surfaces?
questions.idealAnswer: It reduces or eliminates general corrosion issues.

questions.question: What reference material should be used to determine if a control surface must be checked or rebalanced after painting?
questions.idealAnswer: Always refer to the specific AMM (aircraft maintenance manual) for the particular aircraft being painted.

questions.question: What are the three most commonly used methods for applying paint?
questions.idealAnswer: Dipping, brushing, and spraying are the most common ways to paint a modern aircraft.

concepts.label: spraying are the most common ways to paint a modern aircraft
terms: spraying are the most common ways to paint a modern aircraft

questions.question: What is the effect on paint finishes if too much dryer is added to the paint?
questions.idealAnswer: The paint film will be brittle, and will tend to crack and peel.

concepts.label: The paint film will be brittle
terms: the paint film will be brittle

questions.question: What paint system may be used with epoxy topcoats?
questions.idealAnswer: Any paint system may be used. Most common spraying, dipping and brushing.

concepts.label: Any paint system may be used. Most common spraying
terms: any paint system may be used. most common spraying
